Description: Runs hybrid lexical + semantic + rerank search with live stage toggles and preview slot handoff
Finds a document by filename across the selected knowledge base workspace
Opens a picker over recently visited KB files, shared live with the AutoDoc TUI
Picks documents connected to the active file by relation kind, outgoing links, and backlinks
Lists all workspace documents that link to the current buffer
Jumps back to the previously opened knowledge base document
Toggles the docked KB, document outline, symbols, and todo drawer
Selects the active KB workspace for search, pickers, and drawer views
Links the project's primary KB to an AutoDoc workspace, creating one if needed
Opens or focuses the floating Markdown preview slot, restoring its saved cursor position
Renders the current buffer into the specified floating slot with live TextChanged debounce
Picks a Markdown file under cwd into a slot, or closes all open floats while keeping pins
Exports the Markdown document (with rendered Mermaid diagrams) and opens it in the browser
Executes the checksummed 6-stage v2 KB layout migration with full pre-image rollback
Restarts the daemon, rebuilds/installs the binary, or runs Neovim health diagnostics
